§6Industrial Steam Turbine§f

§aNeed more power? This is the turbine that actually delivers.§f

The §bIndustrial Steam Turbine§f is a pseudo-multiblock machine that crushes the single-block turbine in every way. It has §e100%§f conversion efficiency. No other turbine matches that.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Factory):
§b•§f 16× Steel Plate, 4× Rubber Bar, 2× Titanium Steam Turbine, 4× Dense Gold Wire
§b•§f 4× High-Speed Steel Pipe, 2× Integrated Circuit Board

§6Power per Stage§f:
§b•§f §bUltra Dense Steam§f (150 mB/t) → §e18 kHE/t§f
§b•§f §bSuper Dense Steam§f (1,500 mB/t) → §e27 kHE/t§f
§b•§f §bDense Steam§f (15,000 mB/t) → §e30 kHE/t§f
§b•§f §bSteam§f (150,000 mB/t) → §e300 kHE/t§f

One full line of turbines produces §e375 kHE/t§f (7.5 MHE/s) and outputs §e1,500 mB/t§f of Low-Pressure Steam.

§6Operation§f: Maintain a 1:1 ratio of turbines per density type. It has a ramp-up period on startup and decay period on shutdown.

§ePS:§f This is the turbine you want for §bPWR§f and §bRBMK§f setups. Don't try to run a large reactor off single-block turbines unless you enjoy watching your base explode.
